title: Privacy panel shows 2 requests after my first message
body:
The README says the counter should stay at 0 after the first message. After sending "hello" the privacy panel showed **2 requests**, both to huggingface.co (`/api/models/...` and a `.json` file).

The model was already downloaded before. Is the app still checking for updates? That would break the "nothing leaves the device" promise.

Chrome 141, Windows 11.
author: philippmossier
